desc: Experience the light, airy, and crunchy delight of Bugles Original Crispy Corn Snacks, a classic snack. Dive into the savory world of these cone-shaped snack chips, offering a symphony of flavor that will have your taste buds singing. Ideal for any time, whether it's chill time or crunch time, munch these one by one or pack them as a salty snack into a lunch box, backpack, or school bag. Choose Bugles as a crispy, flavorful alternative to ordinary chips. Enhance your homemade snack mix or trail mix with Bugles for that extra flavor boost. Keep a bag at home or in the office, ensuring you always have America's favorite cone-shaped snacks on hand to satisfy your cravings. Loved by kids and adults alike, enjoy a uniquely shaped snack that brings fun and flavor to any moment.
features:
TASTY ORIGINAL: Munch on the Bugles Crispy Corn Snacks you know and love, in its classic original flavor. Perfect for any occasion, these Bugles are a great way to satisfy your salty snack cravings

PANTRY AND PARTY FAVORITE: A pantry staple that's delicious and crunchy; A fun alternative to ordinary chips that's a blast to play with

FAMILY SIZE: Perfect for sharing with family and friends; Put out a bowl for party snacks or game night munchies. The family-sized bag ensures there's enough to go around, making it a convenient choice for movie nights or casual get-togethers at home

CRISPY CHIPS: Experience the crunch with every bite of these crispy, crunchy chips. They have an irresistible taste and are a perfect crunchy treat

ENDLESS OPTIONS: Create fun recipes with this simple snack; Makes delicious fun for both kids and kids at heart. Try using Bugles as a crunchy topping on soups and salads or incorporate them into your baking for an unexpected twist
ingredients: Degermed Yellow Corn Meal, Vegetable Oil (coconut and/or palm), Sugar, Salt, Distilled Monoglycerides, Baking Soda. Freshness Preserved by BHT.
